(A) Are you sure? Yun Jihun, their star player, is not playing today.
(B) The Reds. They're the better team.
(C) I didn't know that. Then, I'm not sure.

G: ⓐ Are you sure? It's already 6.
B: Yes, I'm quite sure. The Star Cinema is only 1 km from here.

questions.question:
G: Look at this program, Liam. This Saturday is Science Day, and there are lots of interesting activities.
B: You mean April 21?
G: Yes. All the activities look fun, and they're all free.
B: All of them? Are you sure?
G: Yes, I'm quite sure. I saw it on the poster. Anyway, which ones are you interested in?
B: I want to go to the drone-flying class the most.

Q. What day is Science Day, and is there a fee for the activities?
→ It's on ________ ________ 21, and all the activities are ________.
09. 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
answers: The cake was baked by my mother.
The homework was checked the teacher.
The song was sung by a famous singer.
The invitation was sent to all the guests.
The meeting was held yesterday afternoon.
questions.explainKo: 정답은 2번입니다. (The homework was checked the teacher.)

그녀는 교복을 입을 필요가 없다.
answers: She don't have to wear a school uniform.
She didn't have to wear a school uniform.
She doesn't have to wear a school uniform.
She doesn't has to wear a school uniform.
She doesn't have to wearing a school uniform.
questions.explainKo: 정답은 3번입니다. (She doesn't have to wear a school uniform.)

questions.question: 11. 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법상 바르게 고치지 않은 것은?
answers: The picture was paint during art class. → was painted
The worksheets was prepared for the class. → were prepared by
She had to took a taxi to the station. → had to take
She don't have to wake up early on Sunday. → doesn't have to

ⓑ You don't have to bring your lunch.
ⓒ The movie was producing by a famous director.
ⓓ The story was told to the children yesterday.
ⓔ Does they have to finish the project today?
